weapon_longsword.name: Longsword
weapon_longsword.description: Versatile steel longsword, wielded with one or two hands. Damage: 1d8 slashing (1H) or 1d10 (2H).

weapon_shortsword.name: Shortsword
weapon_shortsword.description: Agile short sword, favored by rogues and duelists. Properties: Light, Finesse. Damage: 1d6 piercing.

weapon_dagger.name: Dagger
weapon_dagger.description: Light and easily concealed blade. Can be thrown. Properties: Light, Thrown, Finesse. Damage: 1d4 piercing.

weapon_handaxe.name: Handaxe
weapon_handaxe.description: Short-hafted hatchet, effective in melee or thrown. Properties: Light, Thrown. Damage: 1d6 slashing.

weapon_greataxe.name: Greataxe
weapon_greataxe.description: Heavy two-handed battle axe, an armor destroyer. Properties: Heavy, Two-Handed. Damage: 1d12 slashing.

weapon_greatsword.name: Greatsword
weapon_greatsword.description: Two-handed longsword, symbol of martial power. Properties: Heavy, Two-Handed. Damage: 2d6 slashing.

weapon_rapier.name: Rapier
weapon_rapier.description: Elegant thin-bladed fencing sword, ideal for duelists and bards. Property: Finesse. Damage: 1d8 piercing.

weapon_shortbow.name: Shortbow
weapon_shortbow.description: Wooden short bow, agile and easy to use on horseback or in tight spaces. Range: 80/320 ft. Damage: 1d6 piercing.

weapon_longbow.name: Longbow
weapon_longbow.description: Long-range bow, preferred by rangers and elves. Range: 150/600 ft. Properties: Heavy, Two-Handed. Damage: 1d8 piercing.

weapon_quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
weapon_quarterstaff.description: Sturdy wooden staff, versatile and unassuming. Wielded with one or two hands. Damage: 1d6 (1H) or 1d8 (2H) bludgeoning.

weapon_mace.name: Mace
weapon_mace.description: Metal-headed mace, effective against heavy armor. Damage: 1d6 bludgeoning.

weapon_warhammer.name: Warhammer
weapon_warhammer.description: Versatile war hammer forged for battle. Property: Versatile. Damage: 1d8 (1H) or 1d10 (2H) bludgeoning.

weapon_spear.name: Spear
weapon_spear.description: Long-shafted spear, versatile for melee or throwing. Range: 20/60 ft. Damage: 1d6 piercing.

weapon_hand_crossbow.name: Hand Crossbow
weapon_hand_crossbow.description: Compact hand crossbow, usable with one hand. Favorite of rogues. Range: 30/120 ft. Damage: 1d6 piercing.

weapon_light_crossbow.name: Light Crossbow
weapon_light_crossbow.description: Light crossbow, easy to handle, popular among novice adventurers. Range: 80/320 ft. Damage: 1d8 piercing.

armor_leather.name: Leather Armor
armor_leather.description: Hardened leather armor, light and silent. AC 11 + DEX mod. Light Armor.

armor_studded_leather.name: Studded Leather
armor_studded_leather.description: Leather reinforced with metal rivets. AC 12 + DEX mod. Light Armor.

armor_chain_shirt.name: Chain Shirt
armor_chain_shirt.description: Chain shirt protecting the torso without greatly restricting movement. AC 13 + DEX mod (max 2). Medium Armor.

armor_chain_mail.name: Chain Mail
armor_chain_mail.description: Full armor of interlocked metal rings. AC 16. Heavy Armor. Stealth Disadvantage.

armor_plate.name: Plate Armor
armor_plate.description: The finest conventional armor available. Articulated metal plates cover the entire body. AC 18. Heavy Armor. Stealth Disadvantage.

armor_shield.name: Shield
armor_shield.description: Wooden shield with metal reinforcement. Wielded in one hand, grants +2 to AC.

armor_hide.name: Hide Armor
armor_hide.description: Rustic armor made of thick hides and furs. AC 12 + DEX mod (max 2). Medium Armor.

armor_half_plate.name: Half Plate
armor_half_plate.description: Metal plates covering the torso and shoulders, with chain mail elsewhere. AC 15 + DEX mod (max 2). Medium Armor.

gear_rope_hempen.name: Hempen Rope (50 ft)
gear_rope_hempen.description: 50-foot roll of sturdy hempen rope. Holds up to 900 lbs. Essential for climbing and traps.

gear_rope_silk.name: Silk Rope (50 ft)
gear_rope_silk.description: 50-foot roll of silk rope, lighter and stronger than hemp. Favored by rogues.

gear_torch.name: Torch
gear_torch.description: Torch that illuminates a 20-foot radius for 1 hour. Can be used as an improvised weapon (1d4 fire).

gear_lantern_hooded.name: Hooded Lantern
gear_lantern_hooded.description: Hooded lantern with adjustable hood that can be closed to block light. Illuminates 30 ft bright + 30 ft dim for 6 hours (1 oil flask).

gear_oil_flask.name: Oil Flask
gear_oil_flask.description: Oil flask that fuels lanterns for 6 hours. Can be thrown as an incendiary projectile (fire damage in area).

gear_healers_kit.name: Healer's Kit
gear_healers_kit.description: Kit with bandages, salves, and splints. Contains 10 uses. Stabilizes a creature at 0 HP without a Medicine check.

gear_tinderbox.name: Tinderbox
gear_tinderbox.description: Box with flint, steel, and tinder to start a fire in 1 action (or 1 minute in adverse conditions).

gear_rations.name: Rations (1 day)
gear_rations.description: One day's provisions: dried meat, hardtack, cheese, and dried fruit. Enough to sustain an adventurer in the field.

gear_waterskin.name: Waterskin
gear_waterskin.description: Leather waterskin with capacity for 4 pints of liquid. Heavy when full, light when empty (0.5 lb).

gear_grappling_hook.name: Grappling Hook
gear_grappling_hook.description: Iron grappling hook with 4 prongs to catch on ledges and surfaces. Used with rope for climbing.

gear_crowbar.name: Crowbar
gear_crowbar.description: Iron crowbar that grants advantage on Strength checks to open locked doors and chests.

gear_bedroll.name: Bedroll
gear_bedroll.description: Rollable sleeping mat for rest in the field. Provides adequate long rest in hostile environments.

gear_spellbook.name: Spellbook
gear_spellbook.description: Leather-bound spellbook with 100 blank pages. Essential for wizards to record their spells.

gear_component_pouch.name: Component Pouch
gear_component_pouch.description: Small pouch with compartments containing all non-costly material components for spellcasting.

gear_mirror_steel.name: Steel Mirror
gear_mirror_steel.description: Polished steel mirror. Useful for seeing around corners, identifying vampires, and signaling allies at a distance.

potion_healing.name: Potion of Healing
potion_healing.description: Bright red liquid that restores 2d4+2 hit points when drunk as a bonus action.

potion_greater_healing.name: Potion of Greater Healing
potion_greater_healing.description: Potent healing potion that restores 4d4+4 hit points. Glows intensely when shaken.

potion_superior_healing.name: Potion of Superior Healing
potion_superior_healing.description: Superior healing elixir that restores 8d4+8 hit points. Reserved for seasoned adventurers.

potion_antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
potion_antitoxin.description: Antidote that grants advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour. Not a magical potion.

potion_climbing.name: Potion of Climbing
potion_climbing.description: When drunk, you gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed and advantage on climbing checks for 1 hour.

potion_fire_breath.name: Potion of Fire Breath
potion_fire_breath.description: After drinking, you can use a bonus action to breathe fire in a 30-ft cone (4d6 fire, DC 13). Can be used 3 times within 1 hour.

tool_thieves.name: Thieves' Tools
tool_thieves.description: Case with lockpicks, miniature mirrors, clamps, and tweezers. Required to pick locks and disarm traps.

tool_herbalism_kit.name: Herbalism Kit
tool_herbalism_kit.description: Kit with pouches, scissors, mortar, and medicinal herbs. Allows creation of antitoxins and non-magical healing potions.

tool_alchemist_supplies.name: Alchemist's Supplies
tool_alchemist_supplies.description: Alchemy equipment: two glass flasks, a Bunsen burner, a pair of tongs, and various reagents.

tool_cartographer.name: Cartographer's Tools
tool_cartographer.description: Cartography instruments: parchments, compasses, rulers, and special ink for creating and reading maps.

tool_disguise_kit.name: Disguise Kit
tool_disguise_kit.description: Disguise kit with cosmetics, false hair, extra clothing, and accessories to change your appearance.

tool_poisoner_kit.name: Poisoner's Kit
tool_poisoner_kit.description: Kit for preparing and applying poisons: flasks, syringes, gloves, and basic reagents.

tool_lute.name: Lute
tool_lute.description: Lute with a rounded soundbox. Classic bard instrument. Allows use of string instrument proficiency.

magic_bag_of_holding.name: Bag of Holding
magic_bag_of_holding.description: Magic bag with an extradimensional interior: holds up to 500 lb / 64 cu ft, regardless of external weight. Opening inside a folded space causes an explosion.

magic_cloak_protection.name: Cloak of Protection
magic_cloak_protection.description: Enchanted cloak that grants +1 to AC and all saving throws while worn. Requires attunement.

magic_ring_protection.name: Ring of Protection
magic_ring_protection.description: Magic ring that grants +1 to AC and all saving throws. Requires attunement.

magic_boots_elvenkind.name: Boots of Elvenkind
magic_boots_elvenkind.description: Enchanted elven boots that silence your footsteps. Advantage on Stealth checks related to movement. No attunement required.

magic_amulet_health.name: Amulet of Health
magic_amulet_health.description: Amulet that sets your Constitution to 19. No effect if your Constitution is already 19 or higher. Requires attunement.

magic_+1_longsword.name: +1 Longsword
magic_+1_longsword.description: Longsword enchanted with +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls. The blade faintly glows in the dark.

magic_wand_magic_missiles.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
magic_wand_magic_missiles.description: Wand with 7 charges. Expend 1-3 charges to cast Magic Missile at corresponding levels. Regains 1d6+1 charges at dawn.

magic_sending_stones.name: Sending Stones
magic_sending_stones.description: Pair of enchanted polished stones. Once per day, the holder can transmit a 25-word message to the holder of the paired stone.

ammo_arrows_20.name: Arrows (20)
ammo_arrows_20.description: Quiver with 20 wooden feathered arrows. Compatible with short and long bows. On a miss, the arrow is lost 50% of the time.

ammo_bolts_20.name: Crossbow Bolts (20)
ammo_bolts_20.description: Case with 20 crossbow bolts. Compatible with light and hand crossbows. Heavier than arrows, more penetrating.

ammo_sling_bullets_20.name: Sling Bullets (20)
ammo_sling_bullets_20.description: Twenty lead spheres for a sling. Cheap and plentiful, but require a sling to use. Damage: 1d4 bludgeoning.

ammo_silvered_arrows_5.name: Silvered Arrows (5)
ammo_silvered_arrows_5.description: 5 silver-tipped arrows. Overcome resistance and immunity to non-magical damage from undead and lycanthropes.

container_backpack.name: Backpack
container_backpack.description: Sturdy leather backpack with capacity for 30 lbs (1 cu ft of volume). Basic item for any adventurer.

container_chest.name: Chest
container_chest.description: Metal-reinforced wooden chest with capacity for 300 lbs (12 cu ft). Can be locked with a padlock.

container_pouch.name: Pouch
container_pouch.description: Small leather pouch for carrying coins or spell components. Capacity: 6 lbs / 1/5 cu ft.

container_quiver.name: Quiver
container_quiver.description: Leather quiver holding up to 20 arrows or bolts. Enables quick ammunition draw in combat.

container_scroll_case.name: Scroll Case
container_scroll_case.description: Cylindrical leather or bone case for storing and protecting up to 10 scrolls from damage and moisture.

container_saddlebags.name: Saddlebags
container_saddlebags.description: Pair of saddlebags with a total capacity of 60 lbs. Attached to the flanks of a mount.
